records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Union Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Totally understandable that other things have taken priority this week — no rush on my end.

When you do get a window, the quickest way in is creating a first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. And whenever your team is ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm happy to set up your first project with you on a 15-minute call this week — just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around you.

Best,
Chidi
